svg.title: Stage 1I migration pipeline: 18 steps
svg.desc: Twenty cards in four rows: steps 1 to 6 from Stage 1C to 1G (source, cold copy, characterization, qemu-img and virt-v2v), steps 7 to 9 Gate I1 (guest agent, network adaptation, immutable image), step 10 Gate I2 (isolated boot test), the Gate I3 platform, steps 11 to 18 Gate I4 (transfer, CDI import, PVC on EBS, VM, VMI, virt-launcher, QEMU/KVM boot, nginx through NodePort), and Gate I5 (final validation and controlled teardown, sub-gates I5-A to I5-J) PASS: the VM, its disk and the AWS platform were removed and verified.
svg.text: The migration pipeline: 18 numbered steps, five gates
Read left to right, row by row - every step has evidence in the records
a running VM locks its VMDK
the same page as the source
I3 built the AWS target; I4 starts
Steps 1-10 ran on the laptop; the I3 platform and steps 11-18 ran on AWS. Step 18 is the primary proof: the same page, end to end.
